拖动货架上的商品，每格放齐三个相同商品即可清空。整理全部 16 组，在时间和步数: Drag goods between shelves. Three identical goods clear a shelf. Sort all 16 sets before time or moves run out.
落石持续从上方逼近。消除相邻同色图块，让 Sera 沿楼梯前进并清除出口的 70: Rocks are falling. Match adjacent colors to clear all 70 exit blocks and help Sera escape. Avoid the falling rocks.
70 块出口障碍清空，Sera 逃离落石区域: All 70 exit blocks are clear. Sera is safe!
落石接触人物、时间或移动步数耗尽: A rock hit Sera, or time or moves ran out.
消除各列图块来击碎水塔底部八块石板，形成排水口。水位降下后 Sera 脱困；水满: Match tiles in each column to break eight stone plates and drain the tower. Keep the water below the danger line.
八块石板击碎且水塔排空，Sera 脱困: All eight plates are open. Sera escaped the water!
水位达到危险线、时间或步数耗尽: The water reached the danger line, or time or moves ran out.
消除绿色叶片积攒水球，充满后点击横杆释放一批水球。完成三轮降温救出 Sera；红: Match green tiles to charge water balls, then tap the pin to release them. Release three batches to save Sera. Red feeds the fire.
释放三批水球并熄灭火焰: Three water batches released. The fire is out!
火势达到危险线、时间或步数耗尽: The fire reached the danger line, or time or moves ran out.
两间连续机关房：先用黄色图块打开清水闸灭火，再放水冷却熔岩形成出路。消除过多红色: Escape two rooms. Match yellow to open clean water, put out the fire and cool the lava. Too much red opens the dangerous valve.
两间机关房完成，Sera 沿冷却的出路离开: Both rooms are safe. Sera crossed the cooled lava!
打开危险闸、时间或步数耗尽: The dangerous valve opened, or time or moves ran out.
按麻将接龙规则配对 68 张牌：上方无遮挡且至少一侧空着才能选择。五次错配、无法: Match all 68 tiles. A free tile has nothing above it and at least one open side. Avoid five mismatches and beat the timer.
五次错配、无可用配对且洗牌耗尽，或超时: Five mismatches, no pairs or reshuffles left, or time ran out.
两关缠绕解谜：第一关保持 28 条不规则路线，通关后解锁 200 箭头地狱关。密: Clear 28 arrows to unlock the 200-arrow Hell level. Pan and pinch to zoom up to 4x. Avoid three collisions and beat the timer.
先完成 28 箭头第一关，再解开 200 箭头地狱关: Clear 28 arrows, then solve all 200 in the Hell level!
三次碰撞或时间耗尽: Three collisions, or time ran out.
点击半透明色块释放，拖动可调整落点: Tap a translucent block to release it. Drag to adjust its landing position.

先推灰球破石台，再放紫色盖板: Break the stone, then drop purple.

点击积木释放，搭成上方图案。: Tap blocks to build the target shape.

石牌触碰到槽顶。点击 RETRY，试试另一列。: Tiles reached the top. Tap Retry.
点击一列，投放石牌: Tap a column to drop a tile
